principle: One live authority for each mechanism. Multiple states, species, art drafts and measured outcomes are permitted; competing runtime definitions are not.

autonomousPopulationFounding.note: Versioned demographic observation of actual residence, maintenance and paid surviving recruitment. No player ownership, resources, mating or species identity authority is introduced. Natural acceptance remains under verification.

residentFaunaViews.note: Read-only surface views of actual canonical resident snapshots, bounded by the synchronized life stride and real anatomical/physical sight. No rendering-created animals, duplicate biological engines, remote damage, source RNG advances or unvisited population founding. Creator-selected approach retains real ID and revalidates ownership/visibility before and after canonical movement.

regionalPointerNavigation.note: A creator-selected visible neighbouring ground point remains an ephemeral planetary-coordinate route across actual canonical transfer receipts. Planning reuses the shared physical transect and body occupancy, while playerControlStep and planetary-travel.js alone execute movement/costs/transfer. No remote feeding, inspection, fauna ownership or saved biology policy is granted.

regionalSceneHandoff.note: Region-aware native terrain cache promotion and archived departing terrain keep the existing canvas scene visible across canonical regional transfer. Actor/input/sensing targets are invalidated. This is presentation ownership only: planetary-travel.js still owns all organism transfer, clocks, stocks and costs; no saved movement or biology policy changes.

floraGenotypeRetention.note: Retain every genotype referenced by positive seed cohorts, adults, ancestry, reproductive stocks, receipts and carried records. Only nonpositive seed rows and unreferenced definitions may be collected; allocation optimizations do not change biology or saved policy.

planetaryBrowserWork.note: Browser-only fair admission of destination, border, residency and far-biology jobs, one per animation frame with asynchronous exclusion and obsolete-owner rejection. Canonical replay, physical resources and save publication remain owned by existing authorities; no ecological ticks are skipped or clocks advanced by this scheduler.

subsurfaceGeometryAndMaterial.note: For opted excavated-subsurface/1 worlds, physical solid terrain is surface elevation minus open cavity volume. Cavities are excluded space, not another inventory. Excavated material raises actual surface spoil; collapse subsides the roof. Cumulative excavation/collapse values are receipts. Existing runoff operators conserve their own surface-height deltas. Historical missing-policy worlds retain their recorded geometry.

costedCourtshipPerformance.note: Per-action finite ritual and optional target-specific reception; rival winner is only a preference, never a reproductive veto. Opted reproductive-similarity/1 worlds use existing appearance distance, inherited tastes and evolutionary-tree affinity for a bounded reception advantage subordinate to the existing receptive-partner and conception authorities. See docs/REPRODUCTIVE-SIMILARITY-2026-10-26.md.

courtshipActionCapabilities.note: Five ritual action capabilities require actual mounted part definitions; approach never requires part.

learnedRituals.note: Per-animal bounded learning and witnessed success; no species-specific fixed script. Only simulation.tryMate performs conception.

physicalBreedingFieldGuide.note: Read-only display of actual mounted parts and parent body plan snapshots; mating/crossover unchanged.

eggNestsCarePredation.note: Finite optional nests/energy/vegetation, one care action per nest-day and hunter egg consumption. Simulation alone owns egg birth/hatch, world remains vegetation authority.

nativePartArtwork.note: Art-only runtime catalog; single indexed codec and procedural fallback. Registered biological identities remain in part-registry.js; count is derived, never a fixed milestone.

verifiedScenarioCheckpoints.note: Scenarios package and restore the actual canonical full save, preserving stored RNG, every creature's lineage and controller inventory, water and geology. The graph codec only transports structured-clone-compatible state. Recorded source snapshots are immutable; developer repeats and player starts independently decode and restore and never overwrite the original checkpoint. Curated entries require a real saved-state replay check and a SHA-256-verified package; the catalog remains empty until honest simulation-exported samples exist. Full-from-day-1 evolutionary progression remains a separate necessary validation.

inheritedYoungClimate.note: New planetary worlds opt into inherited-young-climate/1 only alongside inherited embryo climate. Existing climate alleles, actual local temperature and humidity cause age-bounded cold energy and hot hydration expense in the canonical shared organism metabolism for live-born and hatched young. Nursing parents with endothermy and fur can counter neonatal exposure only through the previously funded maternal-warmth energy debit. No new young-life reserve, birth probability roll, named-taxon advantage or changes to older unmarked planetary saves; advanced warmth options do not change historical callers.

inheritedEmbryoClimate.note: New planetary environments opt into inherited-embryo-climate/1. Real local temperature and soil moisture act on each egg's maternal and paternal conception-frozen climate genes; existing egg hydration pays measured daily evaporation. Constructed nests reduce risk from finite paid material/care without overriding flooding. Egg/live-bearing anatomical dual strategies consult maternal inherited site fitness. The canonical egg.condition and egg.hydration are the only viability and water stores; no assigned species advantage, new allele, free clutch, new stochastic roll, or changed historical save semantics.

seasonalCoatPhysiology.note: Modern planetary worlds opt into funded-seasonal-coat/1. Inherited dorsal filament, fur, feather and wing parts can grow or shed an observed, saved coatDensity (0..1) according to physical local and regional temperatures. Growth debits the canonical creature energy inventory and cannot spend below a physiological reserve; shedding refunds no energy. Existing inherited wax-plates reduce rain/immersion soaking only for physically mounted covers and retain their registry upkeep, temperature and ancestry costs. Native filament, fur and feather overlays follow saved density in eight quantized visual levels; sprite cache keys include the same scale bin. Wings retain their original aerodynamic outline. Old policy-free worlds keep their exact earlier static covering benefits and wetness calculation.

inheritedCoatMoisture.note: New-world inherited-coat-moisture/1 is a persisted creature condition, not water or energy inventory. Mounted inherited fur, feathers, filament or wings acquire finite saturation from rain and actual immersion and dry in response to temperature and soil humidity. Thermal survival costs remain charged by the preexisting metabolism; save restoration checks finite 0..1 wetness. Historical policy-free planetary and other worlds retain instantaneous climate cover physics; species names and player ownership confer no benefit.

planetaryChannelTopology.note: New-world funded-temporary-channels/1 retains a Uint8 floodOrigin ownership mask for physical runoff-created water. Existing synchronized topology transitions fund new cells from overland, return shallow unsalted owned water into overland when it recedes, and record the source/sink without changing coastline geography. The water mask, environment.volume, environment.overland, and immutable baseline depth remain their canonical authorities; older policy-free worlds never acquire fabricated flood provenance.

planetaryWetbedSediment.note: New-world conserved-wetbed-displacement/1 couples existing terrain elevation deposition to an equal decrease in a wet receiving cell water column and an equal increase in adjacent connected wet water volume, advecting real salt. The canonical terrain.elevation, environment.volume and environment.salt remain sole physical stocks; runoff receipts and regional transfer histories record the displacement. Closed pools and unsupported older saved worlds remain unchanged.

planetaryTerrainSediment.note: New-world opted conserved-runoff-sediment/1 stages small water-funded transfers of actual mutable Float32 terrain.elevation between adjacent dry land cells, with finite bounded source loss and receiver deposition, no added sediment stock. Drainage is re-derived after local/active changes and archived height persists in terrain snapshots. Wet riverbeds and water-mask changes are deferred to separately coupled topology authority. Historical saved worlds lacking the policy do not erode.

planetaryRunoffMinerals.note: Opt-in conserved-runoff-minerals/1 mobilizes a bounded fraction of existing plantResources.minerals only when local or paired downhill runoff actually moves water. Both dry soils and existing wet aquatic producers draw from this canonical finite mineral reserve. No duplicate nutrient or sediment stock, speculative fertility generation, or unloaded-region exchange.

planetaryGroundwaterSprings.note: New-world opt-in funded-groundwater-springs/1 converts Float32-rounded, terrain-exposed soilWater.groundwater into the existing Float64 planetary runoff sink. Soil spring discharge appears as an output; identical surface runoff appears as a credited input. Wetland observations require current waterlogged soil and nonzero overland water. Saved worlds without spring eligibility and springPolicy retain old hydrology.

planetarySeamGroundwater.note: Policy paired-land-groundwater/1 stages finite hydraulic-head flow from one region-owned soilWater.groundwater stock into another at synchronized terrestrial seams. The existing seam transaction publishes paired soil-water receipts, not surface-water inventories. Historical missing-policy saves retain closed regional groundwater borders.

planetaryBoundaryWater.note: Versioned finite external ocean/freshwater reservoir exchange. Policy /2 gives physically synchronized visited wet regions exclusive paired ownership of each cardinal boundary, including partial corner exchange; policy /1 and absent-policy saves retain historical behavior. Worldwide unsimulated ocean resources are not globally conserved.

authoredFounderStart.note: Explicit creator-authored founder pair enters an independent chosen ecosystem through canonical spawning, anatomy, resources, reproduction and persistence. External introduction receipts record initial mass/energy/hydration; no fabricated ancestors, biological births or backdated existence. Guided design traces are authored precursors, sandbox unlocks ancestry without bypassing shared structure/viability.

authoredPrecursorDesign.note: Replay-validates complete authored body-design sequences using the existing draft authorities. Saved design packages preserve mode and precursor trace. This is not a simulated evolutionary lineage.

existingResidentStart.note: Explicit creator choice of an actual living regional resident on an independent world fork. Preserves biological stocks, RNG, body, age, generation and real ancestry; records player-entry provenance, updates playable descendants and carries entry identity through regional saves. Never fabricates simulated evolution or custom anatomy.

movementRuleAdoption.note: Explicit future movement policy adoption on an isolated validated checkpoint continuation. Source/clock/backup receipts and canonical synchronized regional agreement are validated; bodies, resources, RNG and past events are preserved. SaveManager owns atomic untouched-source backup plus continuation storage, readonly backup guards and activation ordering. Ordinary restoration never adopts policies. Failed commits roll candidate metadata back; unsupported environmental-only regional clocks require explicit conversion.

finiteSurfaceIce.note: New finite planetary worlds record finite-surface-ice/1; historical adoption requires the existing atomic source backup. Frozen water is a subset of existing environment.volume, never an added stock. Phase, brine capacity, liquid-only transport and fracture preserve the same owners. Growth-scaled body load, shared support/routes and summed occupants cause real fracture and costed escape/drowning; liquid contact governs coats, gills, drinking and food. Historical worlds remain unchanged. Aerial landing impacts, bounded liquid-clearance breathing routes and exact regional persistence share the same owners. Fixed-reservoir maps and final thermodynamic/snow/art coverage remain open. See docs/SURFACE-ICE-2026-10-20.md.

ballisticJumping.note: New worlds record ballistic-jumping/1. Actual spring legs, anatomical load and existing food/breath fund a committed analytic arc shared by player, wildlife and modern pounce. Existing terrain supplies the vertical datum through gliding.js. Terrain/water impact, recovery, native articulation and saved state are connected. Historical absent-policy worlds retain the older pounce controller. No automatic migration, midair impulse stacking, free landing rescue or fabricated evolutionary evidence.

finiteHeightGliding.note: New worlds record finite-height-gliding/1. Bilateral inherited flank membranes use real terrain/canopy launch height, finite descent and movement energy, bounded steering and terrain/water landings. Player and wildlife share physics. Canopy support and costed climbing remain owned by canopy-site.js; powered flight has a separate metabolism. Historical absent-policy saves preserve movement and mutation choices. No automatic migration or fabricated natural evolution.

directionalFlightWind.note: New planetary worlds record directional-flight-wind/1. Shared airborne movement samples the existing absolute wind field and physical day for heading-dependent speed and finite movement energy costs. No RNG, atmosphere inventory, automatic historical adoption or player-only physics. Renderer and action tooltip display the same observed wind.

planetarySeamScheduling.note: Browser staging and synchronous drains share the same conservative transaction; optimistic read guards restart stale proposals before atomic publication.

nonRuntimeModules.src/render/authored-draft-compiler.js: creature art lab draft compiler; does not publish art to the live part catalog
nonRuntimeModules.src/ui/food-choice-view.js: read-only legacy food selection view retained for compatibility tests; persistent commands use canonical interaction options
nonRuntimeModules.src/lineage/phenotype-resolver.js: legacy Phase A compatibility/reference adapter exercised by evolution and creature assembly contract tests
nonRuntimeModules.src/render/fauna.js: Retired fixed-creature renderer retained for legacy presentation tests and historical source evidence only; live gameplay and current exports use inherited body plans with genvo-draw.js.
nonRuntimeModules.src/lineage/swimming-review.js: Review-only swimming policy exercised by tests/swimming-review.mjs; not live movement authority.
nonRuntimeModules.src/organisms/tissue-construction.js: Experimental material funding kernel exercised by tests/tissue-construction.mjs; not complete runtime tissue conservation.
nonRuntimeModules.src/organisms/tissue-ledger.js: Experimental material ledger exercised by tests/tissue-ledger.mjs and tissue-construction tests; preserve historical accounting contracts.
nonRuntimeModules.src/persistence/fauna-page-checkpoint.js: Standalone checkpoint contract tested by tests/fauna-page-checkpoint.mjs; live persistence uses current save/region authorities.

derivedReferences.references/generated-sprite-sheets: exported images generated from gameplay render functions; never gameplay imports
derivedReferences.tools/creature-lab: isolated authoring UI for editable source art; its drafts are not automatically installed

historicalArtifacts: reports/ contains observations and preserved executable test/capture fixtures. It is not live runtime authority; do not remove fixtures or rewrite receipts merely because a design is superseded.
browserExport: tools/export-public.mjs (uses tools/source-graph.mjs, shared with the audit)
releasePolicy: A development checkpoint is not a stable release; stable manifest may only be updated after full acceptance.
